title: Break circular deps by extracting constants/predicates to leaf files
answers: How do I fix a circular dependency between two frontend modules?
yarn lint:circular flags a new import cycle, how to resolve it
ESLint import/no-cycle error in AppChrome or plugin extensions code
body: Symptom: adding/using a cross-file import of a constant or helper triggers a new circular import path (seen via `yarn lint:circular` or import/no-cycle). Root cause: the constant(s) or a single pure function were colocated in a component/barrel file (e.g. ExtensionSidebar.tsx) or a large multi-export utils file (utils.tsx) that other modules in the same cycle also import from. Fix pattern: extract just that constant/function into its own dependency-free leaf module and point all consumers at it instead of the original file. Constraints: only safe when the extracted symbol has no dependency back on the original file; it's a pure move with no behavior change — verify by re-running `yarn lint:circular` (path count should drop) and the existing test suite.
applies: public/app/core/components/AppChrome/** and public/app/features/plugins/extensions/** (and any other area with eager circular imports)

search: Circular import paths are broken by extracting constants or pure helper functions from shared multi-export component/barrel files into dedicated leaf modules with no external dependencies. Detection via `yarn lint:circular` shows the symptom; root cause is a cross-file import of a symbol colocated in a file (e.g., ExtensionSidebar.tsx, utils.tsx) that other modules in the same cycle also depend on. Fix pattern: move the problematic symbol to its own standalone file (e.g., public/app/features/plugins/extensions/isGrafanaDevMode.ts:isGrafanaDevMode, deepFreeze.ts:deepFreeze) with no dependency path back to the original, then point all consumers at the new leaf module. Constraint: only safe when the extracted symbol has zero dependencies on the original file; it's a pure move with no behavior change—re-run `yarn lint:circular` to verify the cycle count decreases. Applies to public/app/core/components/AppChrome/** and public/app/features/plugins/extensions/** circular-dependency resolution.
